banner.title: Virtual microphone active
banner.description: Select <mono>CABLE Output</mono> as the microphone in Discord and test with the button below.

chooseVoice.title: Choose an online voice
chooseVoice.body: Select an Edge TTS voice before testing.

noModel.title: No model ready
noModel.body: Install Piper or Kokoro before testing.

guide.title: How to use this as a microphone in Discord, VRChat, and games
guide.summary: 4 steps: install VB-Cable, select CABLE Input/Output, enable the virtual mic.

install.title: Install VB-Audio Virtual Cable
install.description: Download it at vb-audio.com/Cable or from Settings > Virtual microphone > Try bundled installer.

selectInput.title: Select CABLE Input in the app
selectInput.description: In Settings > Virtual microphone, choose CABLE Input (VB-Audio Virtual Cable) as the audio output.

setOutput.title: Set CABLE Output in Discord or your game
setOutput.description:
Discord: User Settings > Voice & Video > Input Device = CABLE Output.
VRChat: Settings > Audio > Microphone = CABLE Output; enable voice activation or use PTT.
Other games: point the default microphone to CABLE Output.

enable.title: Enable the virtual microphone on the Speak panel
enable.description: Click Enable virtual microphone. Online and local voices will play directly through CABLE. Global shortcuts (Ctrl+Shift+1..9) work in the background, even with the game focused.

guide.tip: VRChat tip: if the game doesn't detect the mic, open the launcher and click Test output in the Virtual microphone panel — this forces Windows to recognize CABLE Input as active.
